description: This Java source file defines the GeronimoTransactionFactory class, which implements transaction management using Geronimo's transaction manager within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to obtain transaction managers, user transactions, database connections, and handles shutdown procedures.

classes.name: GeronimoTransactionFactory
classes.description: Implements the TransactionFactory interface to provide transaction management using Geronimo within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getTransactionManager
methods.description: Returns the GeronimoTransactionManager instance managing transactions.

methods.name: getUserTransaction
methods.description: Returns the transaction manager as a UserTransaction.

methods.name: getTxMgrName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this transaction manager, 'geronimo'.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Obtains a database connection based on helper info and datasource configuration.
